objects.description: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) has used networkdll for network discovery and psfin specifically for financial and point of sale indicators. [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) has also used [AdFind](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0552), nltest/dclist, and PowerShell script Get-DataInfo.ps1 to enumerate domain computers, including the domain controller.(Citation: FireEye Ryuk and Trickbot January 2019)(Citation: CrowdStrike Grim Spider May 2019)(Citation: FireEye KEGTAP SINGLEMALT October 2020)(Citation: Red Canary Hospital Thwarted Ryuk October 2020)(Citation: DFIR Ryuk's Return October 2020)(Citation: Mandiant FIN12 Oct 2021)
objects.description_fa: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) از networkdll برای کشف شبکه و psfin به طور خاص برای نشانگرهای مالی و نقطه فروش استفاده کرده است. [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) همچنین از [AdFind](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0552)، nltest/dclist و اسکریپت PowerShell Get-DataInfo.ps1 برای شمارش رایانه‌های دامنه، از جمله دامنه استفاده کرده است. کنترل کننده.(Citation: FireEye Ryuk and Trickbot January 2019)(Citation: CrowdStrike Grim Spider May 2019)(Citation: FireEye KEGTAP SINGLEMALT October 2020)(Citation: Red Canary Hospital Thwarted Ryuk October 2020)(Citation: DFIR Ryuk's Return October 2020)(Citation: Mandiant FIN12 Oct 2021)
